_comment: Selling 0.5 USDC for ETH in Coinbase Wallet's Swap. The review screen showed no approval line at all — only the swap. After one 'Swap' press and the password, TWO txs went out: approve() for EXACTLY 0.5 USDC to AllowanceHolder 0x0000…2734, then the swap through it. Extra RPC reads appear (eth_getCode, eth_getBlockByNumber). Approval tx 0xf6e6db78724af41f4f1a6ee32e22e6f1496a6dc9aee8543c7365966f440d3109, swap tx 0xddc862f3a344d85288a8319a80d9a70594192a85e0fb96a09869b5c0b66374f7.
